Talent0_2Ability.name: Coexistence Theory
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: Automatically deploys <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf> when entering the battlefield. <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf> can block Melee, Assault, and Ranged Weapon attacks for allies within <color=#F74848>1</color> adjacent block. <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf> inherits <color=#F74848>75%</color> of Sapientia's ST's Max HP and <color=#F74848>100%</color> of its other attributes.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Coexistence Theory
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
Automatically deploys <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf> when entering the battlefield. <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf> can block Melee, Assault, and Ranged Weapon attacks for allies within <color=#F74848>1</color> adjacent block. <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf> inherits <color=#F74848>75%</color> of Sapientia's ST's Max HP and <color=#F74848>100%</color> of its other attributes.
<buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf>'s Armor is increased by <color=#F74848>35%</color>, its DMG Taken is reduced by <color=#F74848>10%</color>, and it gains an extra <color=#F74848>1</color> AP when deployed.

500001.name: CEC 1
500001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

700015.name: Strategic Redundancy
700015.SpecificEffects: At end of action, if no damage was dealt this turn, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

500803.name: Damage Control
500803.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf> is within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-20%</color>.

500804.name: Synchronized Maintenance
500804.describe: Restores HP to self and all allies within a <range type=2>2-tile diamond area</range> around <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf>. Repair AMT is equal to <color=#F74848>0.85x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

500805.name: Security Topology
500805.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, grants <buf ID=1099905>[Immune to Code Inhibition]</buf> to the target, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

500806.name: Dual Maintenance
500806.describe: Selects <color=#F74848>2</color> allies within a <color=#F74848>4</color>-tile range. Restores HP to all parts of selected STs. Repair AMT is equal to <color=#F74848>1.75x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

500807.name: Integrity Verification
500807.SpecificEffects: At the end of <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf>'s action, restores <color=#F74848>35%</color> of Max HP to the part with the lowest HP.

500808.name: Optimal Reconstruction
500808.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>2.6x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of a single ST. Can repair all destroyed parts, refreshes the remaining turn count of all buffs, and reduces the active cooldown of <color=#F74848>1</color> Code by <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

500809.name: Standard Diagnostics
500809.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>2.0x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of a single ST. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part. If the target is <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf>, additionally applies <buf ID=7100901>[Movement UP]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

summonSkills.name: Super Guggle!
summonSkills.SpecificEffects: Performs <buf ID=1099901>[Guard]</buf>, protecting allies within <color=#F74848>1</color> adjacent tile from Melee, Assault, and Ranged attacks. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times per turn. When performing <buf ID=1099901>[Guard]</buf>, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat.

summonSkills.name: Guggle's Grand Plan!
summonSkills.describe: Protects allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles from Melee, Assault, and Ranged attacks. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times per turn. Lasts for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. Additionally, gains <buf ID=1099902>[Short-Circuit Strike!]</buf> for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns, then gains <color=#F74848>2</color> Extra Movement.

summonSkills.name: Guggle's Encouragement!
summonSkills.describe: Selects <color=#F74848>1</color> other ally within a <color=#F74848>2</color>-block range and restores <color=#F74848>2</color> AP to them.

summonSkills.name: Guggle's Star Shift!
summonSkills.describe: Can select any <color=#F74848>1</color> ally within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles, swap positions with them, and then continue to act using remaining Movement.

500011.name: CEC 2
500011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

500012.name: Part Maintenance 1
500012.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, dispel <color=#F74848>1</color> debuff.

500021.name: CEC 3
500021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

500031.name: Emergency Repair 1
500031.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, randomly select a single adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) ally to perform <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Manipulator Repair AMT and cannot repair damaged parts.

500033.name: Flexible Repair
500033.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, an additional <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

500034.name: Emergency Repair 2
500034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> selects targets within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area.

500035.name: Emergency Repair 3
500035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>'s Manipulator Repair AMT is now <color=#F74848>1x</color> that of the Manipulator.

500036.name: Emergency Repair 4
500036.SpecificEffects: The number of targets that <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> can repair increases by <color=#F74848>1</color>.

500841.name: Intelligent Mecha Innovation 1
500841.SpecificEffects: When casting an active repair skill on <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf>, ignores distance.

500043.name: Part Maintenance 3
500043.SpecificEffects: Each turn, the AP Cost of the 1st repair skill used decreases by <color=#F74848>1</color>, with a minimum cost of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

500845.name: Intelligent Mecha Innovation 3
500845.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf> is present, [Sapientia]'s Repair AMT increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>, and she is immune to <buf ID=1099903>[Code Inhibition]</buf> effects.

500846.name: Intelligent Mecha Innovation 4
500846.SpecificEffects: Allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles of <buf ID=1099900>[Guggle]</buf> can also be targets of active repair skills.
